# Frontend Studio: premium UI, cinematic motion, AI-generated assets, persuasive copy

Curated by Skill Harbor — @minimax-ai's "Frontend Studio" skill for building complete, visually striking web pages. Five orchestrated capabilities: design engineering (design dials — variance/intensity/density — plus opinionated anti-slop rules: never Inter, never AI purple/blue, never centered heroes at high variance, never emojis, never generic cards at high density), motion systems (tool selection matrix — Framer Motion, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Lottie, Three.js, CSS — with mandatory conflict rules and GPU-only animation properties), AI-generated media assets (scripts for image, video, music and TTS generation, never placeholder URLs, assets saved locally), persuasive copywriting (AIDA, PAS, FAB frameworks, headline formulas, CTAs, objection handling), and generative art (philosophy-first static and interactive p5.js modes). Per-framework project structures (pure HTML, React/Next.js, Vue/Nuxt, Svelte/SvelteKit, Astro), brand-override palettes, and hard quality gates — accessibility included (prefers-reduced-motion, no flashing > 3Hz, focus rings, aria-live). Honest caveats: the asset-generation scripts require a MiniMax API key (real usage costs money — budget it before generating); asset prompts must be user-confirmed before generation; the motion/design opinions are strong and prescriptive (anti-emoji, anti-Inter) — follow or override deliberately; sources and third-party docs are acknowledged (taste-skill, Anthropic canvas-design/algorithmic-art, Framer, GSAP, Tailwind)....
